name: Frasers House Singapore, a Luxury Collection Hotel
insider_take: Frasers House Singapore is where colonial Singapore meets modern luxury — a Luxury Collection gem tucked into the storied streets of Tanjong Pagar, one of the city-state's most culturally layered neighborhoods.
whats_special: Housed within a beautifully restored heritage property in Tanjong Pagar, Frasers House seamlessly blends Singapore's rich Straits Settlement past with refined contemporary design. The Luxury Collection designation under Marriott's STARS Program signals a commitment to curating authentic, destination-defining experiences — and this property delivers exactly that. Guests are steps away from Singapore's vibrant CBD, Chinatown, and the historic Ann Siang Hill conservation area, making it an ideal base for both business and cultural exploration.
pro_tip: Book through WhataHotel! to access exclusive Marriott STARS perks including complimentary breakfast, a hotel credit, and potential room upgrades — benefits you simply won't get booking direct or through other platforms.
dont_miss: Just a short stroll from the hotel, Maxwell Food Centre is a legendary hawker center where you can sample some of Singapore's most celebrated street food, including the famous Tian Tian Hainanese Chicken Rice. Also nearby, the Ann Siang Hill Park offers a surprisingly tranquil green escape above the buzz of Chinatown, while Tanjong Pagar Road is lined with beautifully preserved shophouses housing acclaimed restaurants and cocktail bars.
pros: Prime location in Singapore's prestigious Orchard Road district
Luxurious accommodations with sophisticated design and premium amenities
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Access to exclusive Marriott STARS Program benefits and upgrades
cons: Limited on-site dining options compared to larger hotel properties
